## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List meaningful tests and the exact Redmine/database combination. State untested boundaries.
For adapters, cover preview, repeated imports, mappings, conflicts and project isolation.

## Documentation and risks

Link the relevant changelog/guide changes. Describe migration, permissions, historical
metadata or partial-import implications when applicable. Remove credentials and private data.
